markdown:
| Condition                             |   Action | Action                                                                |
|---------------------------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Chemicals or hazardous fluids in eyes |       1. | Hold your eyelids apart forcibly with your fingers.                   |
| Chemicals or hazardous fluids in eyes |       2. | Rinse the eyes with eyewash or running water for at least 15 minutes. |
| Chemicals or hazardous fluids in eyes |       3. | Seek medical attention.                                               |
| Chemicals or hazardous fluids on skin |       1. | Remove contaminated clothing.                                         |
| Chemicals or hazardous fluids on skin |       2. | Wash the skin with soap and water for at least 1 minute.              |
| Chemicals or hazardous fluids on skin |       3. | Seek medical attention, if necessary.                                 |
